scope: Development diagnostics only; existing cohorts were already inspected before this policy was designed.
rule: Compute arithmetic mean of the eight original forest probabilities across HBD runs. Preserve a unique argmax as a proposal. Emit a provisional relationship only if at least two runs have the same unique argmax and a mapped Bonsai label agrees. Exact probability ties, HBD disagreement, a single run, unmapped topology, or topology disagreement produce abstention. Topology never replaces, constrains or propagates the proposal.
decision_rationale: Use abstention for contradictory evidence because neither the forest nor the dog-adapted topology has complete-task validation. Retain forest proposals separately to measure potential utility without certifying them. This can sharply reduce coverage and is not a submission algorithm until independently validated or explicitly revised and re-frozen.
output_contract: Development JSON only, no submission CSV, no default/final-path selection, submission_ready=false even for full agreement.
replay_checks: All legacy final relationship labels must remain unchanged on well-formed retained inputs after deterministic reporting fixes.
Every audited confidence must equal the original forest probability averaged for the final label.
Raw HBD stability and topology-conditioned stability must be separately named.
Historical inputs and outputs must retain their original hashes.
independent_confirmation_requirements: Freeze source, model, preprocessing, map, policy and protocol hashes before new confirmation.
Use independent whole pedigrees and founder haplotypes disjoint from fitting and both development cohorts; do not split correlated rows.
Include all eight accepted labels and multiple pedigrees/topologies, inbreeding strata, realistic matched dog LD/frequencies, supplied family-count behavior, and permitted missing-call conditions.

Score family recovery, all expected within-family pairs with missing/abstained pairs counted as failures, spurious cross-family pairs, per-label confusion and complete-pipeline balanced accuracy. Report uncertainty at the independent family/cohort level.
Compare frozen legacy and development policy against the frozen pair model with the same evaluation cohorts; no retrospective threshold selection or ignoring abstentions.
Specify scientific acceptance criteria in the new protocol before evaluating new confirmation. This development replay supplies no numerical release criterion or certification.
Promote only through explicit complete-task evidence bound to method/model/candidate hashes; no final challenge inference or submission is authorized by this audit.
